knowledge-base.triggers: FastAPI, fastapi, .py, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings, SQLAlchemy, alembic, asyncpg, httpx, oauth2, OAuth2PasswordBearer, APIRouter, Depends, BaseModel, async def, asyncio, starlette
knowledge-base.overview: Framework guardrails, patterns, and best practices for FastAPI. Loaded automatically when agents work on FastAPI projects. Applies to FastAPI 0.100+, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Python 3.10+.

core-principles.principle: Use type hints everywhere; they drive validation, OpenAPI docs, and editor support.
Use async def for I/O-bound endpoints. Use def (sync) only for CPU-bound operations without I/O.
Use Depends() for shared logic and resources — database sessions, auth, services.
Keep route handlers thin. Business logic belongs in services; data access in repositories.
Use Pydantic models for all request/response data. Never expose ORM models directly as responses.

good-fit.item: Building REST APIs or GraphQL backends

consider-alternatives.item: Simple scripts or small apps (use Flask)

guardrail.rule: Never use sync database calls in an async context. Sync DB calls block the event loop and eliminate async performance benefits.
guardrail.good: @router.get("/users") async def list_users(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)): result = await db.execute(select(User)) return result.scalars().all() # async SQLAlchemy

guardrail.rule: Always set response_model on every endpoint. Without it, the ORM model or internal fields may leak in the response.
Never expose ORM models directly as API responses. Always serialize through a Pydantic schema with explicit fields.
Never store plaintext passwords. Hash with bcrypt via passlib before storage.
Set CORS origins explicitly in production. Never use allow_origins=["*"] in a production deployment.
Use Depends() for auth checks on every protected endpoint. Never inline auth logic in route handlers.
Version your API with URL prefixes: /api/v1/... Breaking changes must go in a new version, not the existing one.
Use selectinload() for eager loading relationships in async SQLAlchemy. Lazy loading raises MissingGreenlet in async context.
Use pydantic-settings (BaseSettings) for configuration. Validate all env vars at startup; fail fast with clear errors.
Use the lifespan context manager for startup/shutdown events. The deprecated @app.on_event is removed in FastAPI 0.103+.

directory.purpose: Async SQLAlchemy engine and session factory

project-structure.note: models/ = SQLAlchemy (database shape); schemas/ = Pydantic (API shape); services/ = business logic; repositories/ = data access.

pattern.name: Application Setup with Lifespan
Configuration with pydantic-settings
Pydantic v2 Schemas
pattern.description: Use ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) instead of orm_mode. Use model_dump()/model_validate() instead of .dict()/.from_orm().
pattern.example:
# app/schemas/user.py from datetime import datetime from uuid import UUID
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, EmailStr, Field
class UserBase(BaseModel): email: EmailStr first_name: str | None = None last_name: str | None = None
class UserCreate(UserBase): password: str = Field(..., min_length=8, max_length=100)
class UserUpdate(BaseModel): """Partial update: all fields optional.""" email: EmailStr | None = None first_name: str | None = None last_name: str | None = None password: str | None = Field(None, min_length=8, max_length=100)
class UserResponse(UserBase): model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) id: UUID is_active: bool created_at: datetime
class PaginatedResponse[T](BaseModel): items: list[T] total: int page: int size: int pages: int

pattern.name: Endpoint Pattern
Database Session Dependency
pattern.example:
# app/database.py from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import ( AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine, )
engine = create_async_engine( settings.DATABASE_URL, echo=settings.DEBUG, pool_pre_ping=True, pool_size=5, max_overflow=10, )
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker( engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False, )
async def get_db() -> AsyncSession: async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session: try: yield session await session.commit() except Exception: await session.rollback() raise finally: await session.close()

pattern.name: Auth Dependencies
pattern.example:
# app/api/deps.py from fastapi import Depends from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/v1/auth/login")
async def get_current_user( token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), ) -> User: payload = verify_token(token) user = await UserRepository(db).get(payload.sub) if not user or not user.is_active: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Inactive or missing user") return user
async def get_current_superuser( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), ) -> User: if not current_user.is_superuser: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not enough permissions") return current_user

pattern.name: Custom Exception Hierarchy

async-rules.item: Use asyncpg driver (not psycopg2) for PostgreSQL in async context
Use selectinload() for eager loading relationships (avoids N+1 and MissingGreenlet)
Use await session.flush() to get IDs without committing
Use await session.refresh(obj) after flush to load server defaults
Never call sync ORM methods in async endpoints

rules.rule: Use httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport for endpoint testing
Use pytest-asyncio for async test functions
Use a separate test database; never test against production
Mock external services; never call real APIs in tests

# Development uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
# Production uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4
# Database migrations alembic init alembic alembic revision --autogenerate -m "Initial migration" alembic upgrade head alembic downgrade -1
# Testing pytest pytest -v --cov=app --cov-report=html pytest tests/test_users.py -k "test_register"
# Linting and type checking ruff check app/ ruff check app/ --fix mypy app/

Always set on every endpoint; never expose ORM models directly

yield dependency with commit/rollback/close in finally
selectinload() for relationships (asyncpg); lazy load errors in async
